item.title: CDC sends disease detective to Pennsylvania as measles outbreak grows; 4,410 cases nationwide
item.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced Thursday it will deploy a 'disease detective' from its Epidemic Intelligence Service to assist Pennsylvania as the state grapples with a measles outbreak that has grown to at least 1,200 cases and six deaths, according to state…

item.title: Tech sell-off deepens Friday, capping worst week since June for S&P 500 and Nasdaq
item.description: U.S. stocks ended sharply lower Friday, capping a volatile week in which the technology sector suffered its steepest decline since June. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite dropped 2.1%, while the S&P 500 fell 1% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 0.4%. For the week, the Nasdaq lost 4.5% —…

item.title: Strait of Hormuz attacks hit record as US and Iran trade claims over control
item.description: Dozens of ships were attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz in October, marking the highest monthly tally since the start of the US-Israel war on Iran on February 28, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO).
